marketing.quote: AI generation tools were used to assist in the creation of store marketing assets (such as capsule art)

disclosureQuote: AI generation tools were used to assist in the creation of store marketing assets (such as capsule art) and some in-game item icons. These assets were further reviewed and polished by humans.
summary: 幸存者类动作 Roguelite。开发者披露 AI 生成工具协助制作商店营销素材（如胶囊图）与部分游戏内道具图标，之后再由人工审阅打磨。
reviewNote: 核查 Steam 英文商店页完整 AI 披露、身份（开发商 WarmCore Studio）与英文讨论区首页（可见 15 个主题，总数 282），首页没有与 AI 使用直接相关的主题，未逐帖展开。本款单独检索公开报道 1 次、登记 6 条结果，读取 1 篇原始来源（PCGamesN 对本作发售信息的报道，作者明确谈到 Steam 上的生成式 AI 披露）。领域判定全部来自商店披露原文，结论基于开发者自述，未经独立审计。
description: 官方披露把 AI 用在商店营销素材与部分道具图标上，并说明经人工审阅打磨。

english.summary: A survivors-like action roguelite. The developer states AI generation tools assisted in creating store marketing assets such as capsule art and some in-game item icons, which were then reviewed and polished by humans.
english.reviewNote: Reviewed the full English Steam AI disclosure, the identity (developer WarmCore Studio) and the English discussion homepage (15 visible topics of 282); no homepage topic directly concerns AI use and individual threads were not opened. This title was searched 1 time with 6 results and 1 raw source(s) were read. Every area finding comes from the store disclosure text itself and rests on the developer's own statement, without an independent audit.
